## About
We're a licensed STAR smog check station on Lemon Grove Way. We do all types of smogs for all types of vehicles, plus auto registration services and DMV certified brake and light inspections for salvage and out of state vehicles.
Failed a smog check, or not sure you'll pass? Bring it in. We handle the repairs too, from brakes and tune ups to air conditioning and cooling systems, for American cars and imports.
Drivers around Lemon Grove give us 4.5 stars from 250 Google reviews. We're open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.

## Services
- Licensed STAR Smog Check: We do all types of smogs for all types of vehicles, including cars and trucks.
- Out of State Smog Checks: Bringing a vehicle in from another state? We'll get it smogged.
- Change of Owner Smog Check: The smog check you need when a vehicle changes hands.
- Diesel Smog Check: Smog checks for diesel vehicles too.
- State Certified Brake & Lamp Inspections: Brake and lamp inspections for salvage and out of state vehicles. We examine brakes and headlamps and issue the certificate you take to the DMV to register the vehicle.
- Auto Registration Services: Get registration handled here. One reviewer said we called the DMV and got a suspended registration cleared on the spot.
- Brake Repair: Brake work for cars and trucks. Get your brakes checked regularly so small problems don't turn into costly failures.
- Air Conditioning Service & Repair: Air conditioning service and repair for American cars and imports.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Just come by during business hours, Monday through Friday. One reviewer got an RV smogged without an appointment.

Q: My car failed a smog check. Can you help?
A: Yes. Bring it in and we'll do the smog repairs. If we do the repairs, the re-test is free.

Q: Who needs a brake and light inspection?
A: The California DMV requires salvaged or junked vehicles to have their brakes and headlamps checked by a state-licensed Brake & Lamp Inspection Station before being retitled. We do that inspection and issue the certificate you present to the DMV.

Q: Can you smog an RV?
A: We smog all types of vehicles. One reviewer brought in an RV and said the bays were large and they were in and out without any issues.
